prompt:
Two bodies of mass m1 and m2 travel along a straight line with initial velocities u1 and u2 respectively. They undergo a head-on elastic collision, after which their velocities are v1 and v2.
Starting from the equations for the conservation of linear momentum and the conservation of kinetic energy, derive the relative speed condition:
u1 - u2 = v2 - v1
hints: Group the terms for mass m1 on one side and terms for mass m2 on the other side for both conservation equations.
Use the algebraic identity for the difference of two squares: a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b).
Divide the kinetic energy equation by the momentum equation.
solution:
Step 1: Write the conservation of linear momentum equation:
m1 u1 + m2 u2 = m1 v1 + m2 v2
Rearrange by grouping mass m1 terms on the left and mass m2 terms on the right:
m1(u1 - v1) = m2(v2 - u2)  [Equation 1]

Step 2: Write the conservation of kinetic energy equation:
(1/2)m1 u1^2 + (1/2)m2 u2^2 = (1/2)m1 v1^2 + (1/2)m2 v2^2
Cancel the factor of 1/2 and group masses:
m1(u1^2 - v1^2) = m2(v2^2 - u2^2)
Factor each side using the difference of two squares:
m1(u1 - v1)(u1 + v1) = m2(v2 - u2)(v2 + u2)  [Equation 2]

Step 3: Divide Equation 2 by Equation 1:
[m1(u1 - v1)(u1 + v1)] / [m1(u1 - v1)] = [m2(v2 - u2)(v2 + u2)] / [m2(v2 - u2)]
Assuming u1 != v1, the terms m1(u1 - v1) and m2(v2 - u2) cancel:
u1 + v1 = v2 + u2

Step 4: Rearrange to obtain the relative speed condition:
u1 - u2 = v2 - v1.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Conservation of momentum: m1 u1 + m2 u2 = m1 v1 + m2 v2 => m1(u1 - v1) = m2(v2 - u2).
Step 2: Conservation of kinetic energy: 0.5 m1 u1^2 + 0.5 m2 u2^2 = 0.5 m1 v1^2 + 0.5 m2 v2^2 => m1(u1^2 - v1^2) = m2(v2^2 - u2^2).
Step 3: Factor difference of squares: m1(u1 - v1)(u1 + v1) = m2(v2 - u2)(v2 + u2).
Step 4: Divide Eq 2 by Eq 1 to cancel common factors: u1 + v1 = v2 + u2.
Step 5: Rearrange terms: u1 - u2 = v2 - v1.

mark_scheme.criterion: Expresses conservation of momentum in grouped form: m1(u1 - v1) = m2(v2 - u2)
Expresses conservation of kinetic energy as m1(u1^2 - v1^2) = m2(v2^2 - u2^2) AND factors difference of squares: m1(u1 - v1)(u1 + v1) = m2(v2 - u2)(v2 + u2)
Divides kinetic energy equation by momentum equation to obtain u1 + v1 = v2 + u2 AND rearranges convincingly to u1 - u2 = v2 - v1
